short_blurb: Remodels, additions & ADUs — licensed general contractor in Lakewood.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Lakewood. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Lakewood, including Lakewood Village, Lakewood Park, Lakewood Mutual, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Lakewood?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Lakewood building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Lakewood?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Lakewood rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Lakewood remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
